title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the time t_1.

title: Equation of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the correct equation of motion for the swing's angle.

title: Initial Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the initial conditions to find constants A and B.

title: Use of Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the approximation sin(theta) ≈ theta for small angles.

title: Correct Substitution
description: Optional Criteria: The student may show correct substitution of omega and its relation to g and l.

title: Final Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly determine the condition when theta equals zero.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the equations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student may check for consistency of units throughout the solution.
